title: Dotfiles configuration
description: Non-secret settings owned by dotfiles. Tool-native settings remain in their tool configuration files.

$schema.description: Editor schema location. The CLI uses its own local schema unless --schema is supplied.

schemaVersion.description: Configuration format version. Change only with an explicit migration.

dotfiles.description: Repository-owned orchestration settings. Add named functional domains here as consumers are introduced.

session.description: Graphical desktop session settings (see SESSION.md). Read through configs/session/i3/session-image.sh.

wallpaperImage.description: Desktop wallpaper image. i3 sets it at every start and restart with `feh --bg-fill` (configs/session/i3/configs/session-starts.conf). If the value is missing or the file does not exist, no wallpaper is set and the error goes to stderr. Relative paths resolve from the repository root.

lockScreenImage.description: Lock screen image, independent of wallpaperImage. configs/session/i3/lock.sh shows it with `i3lock-color --fill`, and configs/session/lightdm/setup.sh copies it as the LightDM greeter background. If the value is missing or the file does not exist, lock.sh locks with a solid colour and writes a warning to stderr. Relative paths resolve from the repository root.

imagePath.description: Image file path. A relative path resolves from the repository root; an absolute path is used as is. No tilde or environment-variable expansion occurs.
